verdict.rationale: Appwrite's database docs say its managed database APIs come "with permissions" (appwrite-docs-23), so it does document its own access-control capability. The evidence never says whether those permissions apply per user or per row, or how developers define them. missing for 10: documentation of per-user and per-row (row-level) permission rules, details on how rules are configured and enforced, examples restricting rows to their owning user, independent or hands-on corroboration.
